# Whittle 0.1.1
## New since 0.1.0
- Try Whittle's keyboard controls with a guide that points to the controls in the practice window. Skip anytime or replay it from **Help → Practice Walkthrough**. - Place, name, and edit markers at the start and end of a recording. Whittle saves them with your project. Projects with markers at the recording edges require this version or later. - Press **W** and **E** to jump to either end of the recording. - Press **Shift-F** to fit a selected loop and cue its start when paused. Press **F** to fit the whole recording. - The playhead and timer keep moving when you switch to 10% speed during playback. - Whittle can send crash diagnostics to help fix crashes. To turn reporting off, open **Settings → Privacy**.
